entities.name: Dimethylamine
observations: Decoded as CN(C); nucleophilic amine coupling partner.
Used to convert the substrate carboxylic acid into an N,N-dimethylamide.

entities.name: Acid substrate
observations: Contains a benzoic-acid group and a pre-existing 2,4-dichlorophenoxyacetamide moiety.

entities.name: Dimethylamide product
observations: Formed by replacing the substrate carboxylic-acid OH with N(CH3)2; the existing anilide remains unchanged.

entities.name: Carboxylic acid amidation
observations: Dimethylamine amidation of the acid substrate is the likely transformation.
DIPEA, a poly(dimethylaminomethyl)phenol-type promoter, HOBt, and 1,2-dichloroethane are consistent with coupling conditions.
